title: AI and literature: 'No one in this debate has asked whether a writer has the right to work with a machine'
subhead: Writer Sébastien Bailly regrets that authors are only allowed two stances regarding artificial intelligence: that of the innocent or that of the cheat. Writers should be able to use this tool transparently, he argues for Le Monde.
